themes.disagreements: Varying strength of treatment prediction across candidates, with disease_status (102) showing a weaker signal than ecog_performance_status (109).
themes.interpretation: General disease and performance status markers that strongly correlate with both treatment assignment and outcome prognosis.
themes.name: Functional and Disease Status

themes.disagreements: Dyspnea (106) and dyspnea_on_exertion (107) primarily show confounding signals, whereas dyspnea_severity (108) exhibits strong evidence for both confounding and effect modification.
themes.interpretation: Respiratory symptoms showing consistent prognostic importance and treatment prediction, with graded severity providing heterogeneity signals.
themes.name: Respiratory Burden

themes.disagreements: Different primary drivers of modification: recurrence (101) is supported by R-learners and causal forests, while dizziness (103) is supported by univariable effects and causal forests.
themes.interpretation: Clinical markers that primarily signal treatment-heterogeneity without strong main-effect confounding.
themes.name: Neurological and Recurrence Markers

themes.disagreements: dural_sinus_patency (104) shows moderate predictive forest support for both roles, while edema (110) and dysplasia (105) remain largely unsupportive.
themes.interpretation: Anatomical and pathology findings with weak or inconsistent evidence for causal roles.
themes.name: Anatomical and Pathology Findings
